serverAddress.title: Open Paging Server address
serverAddress.description: Enforces the Open Paging Server address used by the extension.

fullScreenEmergency.title: Full screen emergency messages
fullScreenEmergency.description: Controls whether emergency messages open full screen.

chromeOSOnly.title: ChromeOS only
chromeOSOnly.description: Disables the receiver on devices that are not running ChromeOS.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enables the session debug log and About page link.

hideLoggedOffBanner.title: Hide managed sign-in notification
hideLoggedOffBanner.description: Suppresses the sign-in notification when a managed server has no logged-in receiver.

hideGuestLoginPrompt.title: Hide guest sign-in reminder
hideGuestLoginPrompt.description: Removes the sign-in reminder from the guest receiver's connection notification.

hideDashboardButton.title: Hide Dashboard button
hideDashboardButton.description: Hides the Dashboard button in the receiver popup.

hideServerAddress.title: Hide server address
hideServerAddress.description: Hides the address and sign-in controls, redacts server addresses in logs, and requires ChromeOS.
